{{Top}}
{{Citation}}
[[File:Spy_TotG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] spy meeting with a contact]]
'''Spies''' were individuals that were trained, and sometimes hired, to perform espionage, the practice of obtaining information from rivals or enemies for a military or political advantage. Spies were employed to obtain secrets such as plans or formations of enemy troops. The primary mission of a spy was to collect information, not to fight. Although some spies were skilled in combat, most tried to avoid being detected altogether. The [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] species was well known for being especially good at spying through the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]]. Both the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] practiced spy usage during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] extensively spied out the galaxy prior to their invasion.

==Description==
Spies broadly fell into one of three categories; industrial spies, government spies, or freelance spies. Industrial spies worked in the business world, engaging in corporate espionage. These spies worked for a specific [[Megacorporation/Legends|megacorporation]], and were deployed against competitors. They were usually directed to steal information from rival corporations and sabotage their work as needed. Government spies were loyal to a political entity, and were deployed against rival governments, infiltrating their institutions to gather information. The spies were also deployed internally, maintaining internal security by rooting out spies sent by enemy governments that had managed to infiltrate their own organizations. Freelance spies were available for hire by the highest bidder. Their only loyalty was to their client for as long as they were contracted.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

==History of espionage==
====Spies during the Great Galactic War (14 BTC/3,660 BBY)====
{{Quote|Recent Republic strategic information reports prove that the rise of the Mandalorians was orchestrated by Imperial Intelligence.|Jedi Master Gnost-Dural|audio=OrchestratedByImpIntelligence-Timeline4.flac|<ref name="Timeline4">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 4: The Empire Changes Strategy|int=Timeline 4: The Empire Changes Strategy}}</ref>}}
[[File:ImpIntelAgent-Timeline4.jpg|thumb|right|200px|An Imperial spy on Geonosis, during the Great Galactic War]]
The [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] hired spies during the [[Great Galactic War]]. After a succession of defeats generated by the Sith during the war, ended by the [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]], the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] changed his strategy to ensure victory: [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]].

Their goal was to gain the control and loyalty of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]. The Imperial Diplomats at first sent invitations to the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and the crackpots of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], to join the war efforts. Few of them answered positively; most of them remained neutral. To gain the loyalty of the Mandalorians, the Sith Emperor hired spies. The spies infiltrated the arenas where bounty hunters and other such brawlers fought in the Outer Rim. The Empire infiltrated the arenas as trainers, patrons, and Gladiators.

Imperial Intelligence had noticed a strong Gladiator and made him the puppet of their plans. The Sith Spies drugged and weakened his enemies to make it stronger than any others participants of the Geonosis Arena. The groans of Imperial Intelligence became the spectators' acclamations: "[[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]]! Mandalore!" The Gladiator claimed the title and became the [[Mandalore the Lesser|New Mandalore]]. He summoned his people and allied them to the Imperial war effort. However, Mandalore obeyed Imperial Intelligence. As the puppets of the Sith, the Mandalorians declared war for a [[Mandalorian Wars|second time]] against the Jedi. They also prepared a blockade of the Hydian Way that later would be broken by a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] lead by [[Hylo Visz]] in 7 [[Treaty of Coruscant|BTC]].

====Secession movement====
After tracking [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] infiltrated a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] structure and found the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] leaders and [[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku]] scheming to secede from the Republic, using their droid armies as martial back-up. Kenobi was able to send this vital information to the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], leading to the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

====The first Death Star plans====
[[File:InfiltrateRebelCommandBase-COTF.jpg|thumb|left|200px|An Imperial spy gathering information from a Rebel base following the Death Star's destruction]]
{{Quote|Several transmissions were beamed to this ship by Rebel spies. I want to know what happened to the plans they sent you.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
Prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] uploaded stolen plans for the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] to [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] before her imminent capture by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. These transmissions had been procured from several different sources, including Rebel mercenary [[Kyle Katarn]]. Along with the plans was a hologram message for [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] pleading for his return.

====The second Death Star plans====
The Bothan Spynet secured the plans to the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]], an event during which, famously, "many Bothans died&hellip;" The plans showed that the Death Star was indestructible until shield generators on the moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] were effectively shut down. Thus, the Rebel Alliance was able to effectively attack the new, unfinished but deadlier, Death Star by a ground assault. Despite heavy losses, they were successful, and the second Death Star was destroyed, along with the Emperor. [[File:Bothan_TEA.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Bothan spies appropriated the plans to the second Death Star.]]

====Zsinj campaign====
Zsinj was notorious for employing Imperial intelligence assets in his period of warlordism. He had agents throughout not only the New Republic, but its fleet as well. However, Zsinj suffered heavy defeats from another quasi-spy organization, [[Wraith Squadron]], and especially from a former member, [[Gara Petothel|Lara Notsil]], who pretended to defect but actually was a spy and saboteur.

====The Yuuzhan Vong Intendants====
While their function was originally bureaucratic, the Yuuzhan Vong of the [[Intendant caste]] made extensive use of espionage prior to their massive invasion. Chief among their spies was [[Nom Anor]]. Ultimately, their use of espionage allowed them to gather massive amounts of intelligence on the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] without their machinations (although they would detest the use of that word) being detected. Yuuzhan Vong spies were active and a very real danger throughout the entire war. They also used organizations such as the [[Peace Brigade]] and treacherous senator [[Viqi Shesh]] to gather intelligence. In terms of counterespionage, on some occasions, [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] and its successor, would feed known Vong spies false information. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and Wraith Squadron were also able to infiltrate the captured [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and learn valuable information about the Yuuzhan Vong presence there.
